anchor: The workload is one seven-day production trace with a by-construction 50/50 modality split and arrival-side information only.
claim_text: Workload: 7-day trace, 50/50 modality split, arrival-side info only

anchor: vLLM encoder-attention collector hard-codes no kernel choice
claim_text: The vLLM encoder-attention collector does not hard-code kernel choice; it uses vLLM's backend selector.

anchor: Collection ran inside the pinned production container (vllm/vllm-openai:v0.22.0)
claim_text: Data collection was performed inside the pinned production container vllm/vllm-openai:v0.22.0.

anchor: AIC's estimate for one encoder forward is an arithmetic composition over an operator graph
claim_text: AIC's encoder latency estimate is an arithmetic composition over an operator graph.

anchor: The AIC curve is the postinfill snapshot for $N\le128$ and the composed model beyond
claim_text: The AIC curve represents the postinfill snapshot for batch sizes up to 128 and the composed model for larger batch sizes.

anchor: scored on provisioned GPU-time per hardware class (RTX~5090-class worker-seconds for the encoder pool, H100 GPU-hours for the language pool; never summed across classes).
claim_text: Scoring for provisioned GPU-time is done separately per hardware class: RTX 5090-class worker-seconds for the encoder pool and H100 GPU-hours for the language pool; values are never summed across classes.

anchor: Each burst window brackets its episode with a $\pm$10-minute calm margin
claim_text: Each burst window includes a ±10-minute calm margin around its episode.

anchor: Scale-downs take effect immediately, guarded by a 3-minute hysteresis.
claim_text: Scale-downs take effect immediately with a 3-minute hysteresis guard.
